checks.scope: First independent mathematical, physical, source-fidelity and cultural review of the frozen REPAIR-1 candidate only. Not promotion, review@1 generation, offline acceptance or product acceptance.

currentWholeProse.bodyJoinRule: CURRENT lesson.template.prose entries with kind=p, joined in order with two newline characters; captions remain separate.

independentSourceInventory.basis: Recomputed by opening the actual original PNG at its original resolution, before opening any candidate preview. Neither producer observations nor object counts establish source fidelity.

groups.observation: One continuous horizontal suspended strip with exactly five foil-pair positions. The first, at the left earthed end, is closed/touching; the remaining four openings increase successively toward the generator on the right.
groups.relationshipEvidence: strip-span and all five per-pair on-strip, vector, equal-leaf, length and tip-span assertions resolve. Independent coordinate arithmetic proves the first coincident pair and all four strict increases.

groups.observation: Two ball-top supports, each retaining an upright, broad foot and diagonal strip-end member. A separate coiled lead, not the support foot, joins the left strip end to a descending three-bar earth.
groups.relationshipEvidence: Both post/brace connects and support contact/height/foot assertions resolve. The left electrical lead starts at strip-left, remains continuous and reaches its own earth stem and three decreasing bars.

groups.observation: The right strip end remains connected by a coiled lead over the right support to the left generator terminal. The right generator terminal has its own separate coiled lead and descending three-bar earth.
groups.relationshipEvidence: Every lead segment has a mapped connects assertion. Both terminal/strip endpoints and all intermediate joins are checked independently; both complete earth signs remain visible.

groups.observation: The source retains the same full physical electrostatic generator: segmented disk/rim and hub, diagonal contact member, two separate electrodes, paired vertical jar-like assemblies, lower wheel/rings and hub, drive members, crank and broad platform.
groups.relationshipEvidence: Dimension/terminal-separation assertions and all mechanical connects assertions resolve. Final previews retain the actual apparatus rather than a battery/resistor abstraction.

independentSourceInventory.modernAdditions: English identification labels and clean apparatus geometry; exact 0/16/32/48/64-degree openings, equal 42-unit leaf lengths, regular spacing, 16 regular disk sectors and clean three-bar grounds are modern regularization, not printed source measurements. Scan noise near the generator is not an instructional label or polarity mark; the occluded source does not establish an exact sector count.

mathematicalAndSemanticMappings.method: Independent read-only coordinate arithmetic, reference resolution, source-inventory mapping and lead-chain checks. No native validator or renderer executed.
mathematicalAndSemanticMappings.closedPairExplanation: Both leaves and both tips coincide geometrically at the first position; the single visible stroke means touching/closed foils, not an omitted foil pair.

physicalAndPolarityInterpretation.observation: The added left strip earth and separately earthed generator electrode provide the prose's earth-return closed circuit. Closed foils at the earth end and progressively wider openings toward the driven end show the qualitative potential-magnitude ordering.
physicalAndPolarityInterpretation.signedPotentialCheck: The full corrected prose conditions signed decrease toward earth on a positive connected electrode and explicitly states signed increase for a negative electrode. The same foil-angle pattern cannot identify the sign and does not warrant unconditional signed decrease.

savedNativeEvidence.role: Hash-checked saved producer evidence, supplemented by the independent actual image inspections below; not re-executed.

actualImageReview.usability: At all three actual widths the grounded first pair remains closed and the next four openings are visibly distinct and increasing toward the generator. Both coiled earth leads and complete ground signs can be followed. Both complete supports, terminal assemblies, disk sectors, wheel/hub, drive links, crank and platform remain identifiable at 331 pixels.
actualImageReview.sourceFidelity: Instructional apparatus and relationships are retained with clean line-art simplification; no disconnected schematic substitution, polarity annotation, answer annotation, cultural wording or scan texture.
